<body>
<svg class="svg-library" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true"><defs>
<symbol id="i-door" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 21h16M6 21V3h12v18M13 12h1"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 12h15m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-photo" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="m4 17 5-5 4 4 3-3 5 5"/><circle cx="15.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-sound" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m11 4-6 5H2v6h3l6 5zM15 8c2 2 2 6 0 8m3-11c4 4 4 10 0 14"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-mute" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m11 4-6 5H2v6h3l6 5zM16 9l6 6m0-6-6 6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-play" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m8 4 12 8-12 8z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-pause" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-close" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-map" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m3 5 6-2 6 2 6-2v16l-6 2-6-2-6 2zm6-2v16m6-14v16"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-info" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v6m0-11v1"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-full" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 9V4h5m6 0h5v5m0 6v5h-5M9 20H4v-5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-pencil" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m4 16-1 5 5-1L21 7l-4-4zm10-10 4 4"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-seat" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 12V3h12v9M5 12h14v5H5zm1 5v5m12-5v5"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20h5v-5h5v-5h6V4m-6 0h6v6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-check" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6"/></symbol>
</defs></svg>
<canvas id="world" aria-label="Interactive three-dimensional reconstruction. Use W A S D to walk, drag to look, or choose a location above." tabindex="0"></canvas>
<div class="scene-shade" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="fade" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<header class="topbar">
 <button class="brand" id="homeButton" aria-label="Return to the introduction"><span class="brand-mark"><svg><use href="#i-door"/></svg></span><span><strong>TST<span class="brand-slash"> / </span><span class="brand-word">REVISITED</span></strong><small>A SPATIAL MEMORY</small></span></button>
 <div class="top-actions">
  <button class="icon-button started-only" id="mapButton" title="Floor plan" aria-label="Open floor plan" aria-expanded="false"><svg><use href="#i-map"/></svg></button>
  <button class="icon-button started-only" id="noteButton" title="Your notebook" aria-label="Open personal notebook"><svg><use href="#i-pencil"/></svg></button>
  <button class="icon-button started-only" id="soundButton" title="Turn ambient sound on" aria-label="Turn ambient sound on" aria-pressed="false"><svg><use id="soundIcon" href="#i-mute"/></svg></button>
  <button class="top-button started-only" id="tourButton"><svg><use href="#i-play"/></svg><span id="tourLabel">Guided tour</span></button>
  <button class="top-button" id="albumButton"><svg><use href="#i-photo"/></svg><span class="album-word">Memories</span><span class="counter" id="memoryCount">0 / 7</span></button>
  <button class="icon-button" id="helpButton" title="How to explore" aria-label="How to explore"><svg><use href="#i-info"/></svg></button>
 </div>
</header>
<section id="intro" aria-label="Introduction">
 <div class="intro-photo" id="introPhoto"></div><div class="intro-wash"></div>
 <div class="intro-main">
  <p class="eyebrow"><span class="tiny-line"></span>A DAY, HELD STILL</p>
  <h1>Back in<br><em>the room.</em></h1>
  <p class="intro-copy">The quiet. The dividers. The light on the ceiling.<br> Walk back into a moment you know.</p>
  <button id="beginButton" class="primary-button" disabled><span id="beginLabel">Preparing your room</span><svg><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button>
  <button id="outsideButton" class="text-button" disabled>Or start at the entrance <span>&nearr;</span></button>
  <div id="loadStatus" class="load-status" role="status"><span class="load-dot"></span><span id="loadText">Unpacking seven photographs</span></div>
 </div>
 <div class="intro-foot"><div><span class="eyebrow">YOUR PHOTOGRAPHS, A NEW WAY BACK</span><p>7 memories <span>&middot;</span> 4 places <span>&middot;</span> Your own pace</p></div><span class="intro-photo-label">THE TESTING ROOM <span>/</span> ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH</span></div>
 <button id="arrivalCard" class="arrival-card" aria-label="Begin at the entrance"><img data-photo="arrival" alt="The tree-lined entrance to the service center"><span><small>BEFORE THE DOORS</small>It started here.<svg><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></span></button>
 <div class="intro-index">03 <span>/ 07</span></div>
</section>
<nav id="placeNav" class="place-nav started-only" aria-label="Jump to a place">
 <button data-place="arrival"><span>01</span> Arrival</button><button data-place="hall" class="active"><span>02</span> The room</button><button data-place="desk"><span>03</span> The desk</button><button data-place="overlook"><span>04</span> Overlook</button>
</nav>
<div id="hotspots" class="started-only"></div>
<div class="reticle started-only" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div>
<aside class="place-info started-only" id="placeInfo">
 <span class="eyebrow" id="placeNumber">02 / THE TESTING ROOM</span>
 <h2 id="placeTitle">Right where you left it.</h2>
 <p id="placeDescription">The rows, the light, the quiet concentration.</p>
 <button class="small-action" id="seatButton"><svg><use href="#i-seat"/></svg><span id="seatLabel">Take a seat</span><span>&nearr;</span></button>
</aside>
<div id="contextPrompt" class="context-prompt started-only" hidden><button id="interactButton"><kbd>E</kbd><span id="contextText">Open memory</span><span>&nearr;</span></button></div>
<div class="controls-hint started-only" id="controlsHint"><span class="desktop-hint"><kbd>W</kbd><span class="key-row"><kbd>A</kbd><kbd>S</kbd><kbd>D</kbd></span><span>walk</span><i></i><span>drag to look</span><i></i><kbd>P</kbd><span>hold to remember</span></span><span class="mobile-hint">Left thumb to walk &middot; drag to look</span></div>
<button class="photo-peek-card started-only" id="referenceButton"><img id="referenceImage" alt="Original reference photograph"><span><small>YOUR PHOTOGRAPH</small><strong>See the original <svg><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></strong></span><span class="photo-number" id="referenceNumber">02 / 07</span></button>
<button class="fullscreen-button started-only" id="fullscreenButton" aria-label="Toggle full screen" title="Full screen"><svg><use href="#i-full"/></svg></button>
<div id="tourControls" class="tour-controls" hidden><div class="tour-top"><span><span class="live-dot"></span> A WALK THROUGH THE DAY</span><button id="pauseTourButton" aria-label="Pause guided tour"><svg><use id="pauseIcon" href="#i-pause"/></svg></button><button id="exitTourButton" aria-label="End guided tour"><svg><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button></div><div id="tourProgress" class="tour-progress"><i><b></b></i><i><b></b></i><i><b></b></i><i><b></b></i></div><small id="tourCaption">01 &middot; Before the doors</small></div>
<aside id="mapPanel" class="map-panel" hidden><div class="panel-top"><span class="eyebrow">A SENSE OF THE PLACE</span><button id="closeMapButton" aria-label="Close floor plan"><svg><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button></div><canvas id="minimap" width="520" height="620" aria-label="Floor plan. Choose any of the four numbered locations below."></canvas><div class="map-locations"><button data-place="arrival">01 Arrival</button><button data-place="hall">02 Room</button><button data-place="desk">03 Desk</button><button data-place="overlook">04 Overlook</button></div><small>Interpreted from the photographs. Not to scale.</small></aside>
<div id="joystick" class="started-only" aria-label="Touch movement control"><div id="joystickKnob"></div></div>
<div id="peekOverlay" hidden><img id="peekImage" alt="Original photograph of the current place"><div><span class="eyebrow">A MOMENT, AS IT WAS</span><h2 id="peekTitle"></h2><p>Release <kbd>P</kbd> to return to the room</p></div></div>
<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<dialog id="albumDialog" class="album-dialog" aria-label="Your seven photographic memories">
 <div class="album-header"><div><span class="eyebrow">THE ORIGINALS</span><h2>Seven ways back.</h2></div><button class="close-button" data-close="albumDialog"><span>Back to the room</span><svg><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button></div>
 <div class="album-stage"><button class="album-arrow previous" id="previousPhoto" aria-label="Previous photograph"><svg><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button><img id="albumImage" alt=""><button class="album-arrow next" id="nextPhoto" aria-label="Next photograph"><svg><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></button></div>
 <div class="album-caption"><div><h3 id="albumTitle"></h3><p id="albumCaption"></p></div><span id="albumIndex">01 / 07</span></div>
 <div id="filmstrip" class="filmstrip" aria-label="Choose a photograph"></div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="helpDialog" class="paper-dialog" aria-label="How to explore">
 <button class="dialog-x" data-close="helpDialog" aria-label="Close help"><svg><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button>
 <span class="eyebrow">THERE IS NO RUSH</span><h2>Make yourself<br><em>at home.</em></h2>
 <p class="dialog-lede">Walk around, find a familiar view, or let the guided tour lead the way.</p>
 <div class="help-grid"><div><strong>Move</strong><span><kbd>W</kbd> <kbd>A</kbd> <kbd>S</kbd> <kbd>D</kbd> &nbsp; or arrow keys</span></div><div><strong>Look around</strong><span>Click and drag &middot; double-click for mouse look</span></div><div><strong>Open a memory</strong><span>Click its marker, or press <kbd>E</kbd> nearby</span></div><div><strong>See the photograph</strong><span>Hold <kbd>P</kbd>, or choose &ldquo;See the original&rdquo;</span></div><div><strong>Step away</strong><span><kbd>Esc</kbd> releases the mouse or closes a panel</span></div></div>
 <p class="touch-help">On a phone or tablet, use the left thumb control to walk and drag the scene to look around.</p>
 <div class="settings-row"><label for="quality">Detail level</label><select id="quality"><option value="balanced">Balanced</option><option value="high">High detail</option><option value="fast">Lighter rendering</option></select></div>
 <div class="settings-row"><label for="reducedMotion">Gentler transitions</label><input type="checkbox" id="reducedMotion"></div>
 <div class="about-note"><strong>A reconstruction, not a recording.</strong><p>The space is interpreted from your seven photographs, not a measured 3D scan. People are anonymous stand-ins. Connecting spaces, paper details, and optional ambient sound are recreated. Your original photographs are the source of truth.</p><p>Everything runs in this file. No accounts, uploads, or external assets. Notes and visited memories stay in this browser.</p></div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="noteDialog" class="paper-dialog note-dialog" aria-label="Your personal notebook">
 <button class="dialog-x" data-close="noteDialog" aria-label="Close notebook"><svg><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button><span class="eyebrow">A NOTE TO YOUR FUTURE SELF</span><h2>What stays<br><em>with you?</em></h2><p class="dialog-lede">A problem. A conversation. Just how it felt to be here.</p><textarea id="notebook" placeholder="Something I want to remember..." aria-label="Your memory note" maxlength="20000"></textarea><div class="note-footer"><span id="noteStatus">Saved only in this browser.</span><button id="saveNoteButton" class="small-action dark">Save note <svg><use href="#i-check"/></svg></button></div>
</dialog>
<noscript><div class="noscript">This walkthrough needs JavaScript to move through the room. Enable JavaScript in your browser and reopen this file.</div></noscript>
<script>window.PHOTO_DATA={"arrival":"data:image/jpeg;base64,
